bugs: The profile-scope composition fixture did not register the SB05 conversation read boundary; it now switches profile immediately after the read-store result, preserving the intended whole-use-case test.
The checkpoint found and removed the obsolete public inline engine SendAsync path plus its production implementation and test-double forwarding methods.
deviations: The Unit union was run twice after the first current-head attempt exposed the missing read-store fixture registration; the final post-cleanup no-build union was required to bind proof to the actual implementation head.

The Integration union first ran inside the sandbox: 12 passed and 10 failed solely because the configured LocalAppData control-plane lock was denied. The unchanged authorized rerun passed 22/22; a final no-build pass after legacy-path deletion also passed 22/22.

One of three affected builds failed after the deliberate interface deletion exposed three remaining direct-test callers; those tests were converted to the explicit admit/invoke/complete protocol, and the final Unit and Integration builds passed.
knownGaps: Provider-neutral incremental streaming remains owned by SB07.
Streaming event journal, SSE transport, and authorization remain locked to SB08-SB10 and CP2.
